summary: bioAffinity Technologies filed an 8-K after entering an October 8, 2026 securities purchase agreement with one institutional investor for a registered-direct-plus-private-placement financing. The company sold 116,545 shares at $6.122 and pre-funded warrants for 536,836 shares at $6.115, plus unregistered five-year warrants for 980,072 shares at a $6.122 exercise price, exercisable from stockholder approval, with a 4.99% beneficial-ownership blocker waivable to 9.99%. Shares came off an effective Form S-3 shelf; registration rights were granted. This is an ordinary capital raise, not a special situation; watch warrant overhang and approval timing.
